Manual CLI invocation is blocked in this sandbox (no approval surface for shell commands beyond what already ran), so I verified via `npm test` instead, which exercises the same `list(today, { json: true })` path that `cli.js` calls for `--json`.

Added a `--json` flag to `habit list`: `commands.js`'s `list()` now takes an options object and returns `JSON.stringify([{ name, streak }, ...])` when `{ json: true }` is passed (still returns a string, never prints), and `cli.js` passes `{ json: args.includes('--json') }`. Added two tests covering populated and empty habit lists; all 9 tests pass.
